info.name: ImageKit Account Management API Saved Extensions API

items.docs: This API returns an array of all saved extensions for your account. Saved extensions allow you to save complex extension configurations and reuse them by referencing them by ID in upload or update file APIs.

This API creates a new saved extension. Saved extensions allow you to save complex extension configurations (like AI tasks) and reuse them by referencing the ID in upload or update file APIs.

**Saved extension limit** \
You can create a maximum of 100 saved extensions per account.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique ID of the saved extension.
